title: Structure of a 0-dimensional integer multiplicity triple
statement: Let P ∈ ℕ, U ⊆ ℝ^P an arbitrary set, and R = (M, θ, ξ) ∈ IMRep U 0 as frozen in the contract: M = R.carrier ⊆ U is Borel and countably 0-rectifiable in the sense of Simon Ch. 3, 1.1 (M ⊆ M₀ ∪ ⋃_j F_j(ℝ⁰) with H⁰(M₀) = 0 and F_j : ℝ⁰ → ℝ^P Lipschitz), θ = R.mult : ℝ^P → ℕ is measurable with θ > 0 on M and ∫_{M∩K} θ dH⁰ < ∞ for every compact K ⊆ U, ξ = R.orient : ℝ^P → Λ₀(ℝ^P) = (Λ⁰ℝ^P)* is H⁰⌞M-a.e. strongly measurable, and for H⁰⌞M-a.e. z there is a subspace Q with HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt 0 M z Q (Simon Ch. 3, 1.4 with H⁰) and IsUnitOrientationOf (ξ(z)) Q. Here H⁰ = μHE[0] and μ_R = R.measure = θ·H⁰⌞M. Then: (i) M is countable; (ii) for every compact K ⊆ U, M ∩ K is finite and μ_R(K) < ∞; (iii) for every x ∈ M there is a subspace Q with HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt 0 M x Q and IsUnitOrientationOf (ξ(x)) Q, and ξ(x) ≠ 0; (iv) if U is open, then U ∩ spt μ_R = M.
lean_statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (R : IMRep U 0), R.carrier.Countable ∧ (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → (R.carrier ∩ K).Finite ∧ R.measure K ≠ ∞) ∧ (∀ x ∈ R.carrier, (∃ Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P), HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt 0 R.carrier x Q ∧ IsUnitOrientationOf (R.orient x) Q) ∧ R.orient x ≠ 0) ∧ (IsOpen U → U ∩ R.measure.support = R.carrier)
